name: pest-tests-runner
description: Run Pest PHP tests from the Test Explorer, gutter and CodeLens with real-time streaming, diff view for failures, and Docker / Sail / WSL / monorepo support

pest-tests-runner.projectRoot.markdownDescription: Folder of the Pest project (where `vendor/` and `phpunit.xml` live). Leave empty to detect it from each test file, which supports opening a parent folder or a monorepo. Relative paths and `${workspaceFolder}` are resolved against the workspace folder.

pest-tests-runner.command.markdownDescription: Command used to start Pest, run from the project root, without a shell. Leave empty to use `php vendor/pestphp/pest/bin/pest`. To use a specific PHP, give only its path (e.g. `C:\laragon\bin\php\php-8.3\php.exe`): the Pest script of the project is added automatically. Docker / WSL / Sail: give the full command, e.g. `docker compose exec -T laravel.test php vendor/bin/pest`, `wsl php vendor/bin/pest`, `./vendor/bin/sail pest`. Variables: `${projectRoot}`, `${workspaceFolder}`.

pest-tests-runner.additionalArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to Pest on every run, e.g. `["--parallel"]` or `["--stop-on-failure"]`.

pest-tests-runner.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the Pest process, e.g. `{ "DB_CONNECTION": "sqlite" }`.

pest-tests-runner.disableXdebug.markdownDescription: Set `XDEBUG_MODE=off` for normal runs when PHP runs locally (Xdebug slows every test down). The Debug profile always enables Xdebug.

pest-tests-runner.testFileGlob.markdownDescription: Glob of the files scanned for Pest tests (`vendor` and `node_modules` are always ignored).

pest-tests-runner.enableCodeLens.description: Show Run/status CodeLens above tests, describe blocks and files (the Test Explorer and gutter icons are always available).

pest-tests-runner.autoSaveBeforeRun.description: Save the test files of a run before starting it.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
